title: The Price of Hidden Curvature: Improved Lower Bounds for Bandit Convex Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2607.18652v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We establish improved lower bounds on the minimax expected regret of stochastic bandit convex optimization for $1$-Lipschitz functions on the $d$-dimensional Euclidean ball. For time horizons $n\ge d^{10/3}$, we prove a lower bound of $\Omega(d^{4/3}\sqrt{n})$, the first nontrivial bound that exceeds the $d\sqrt{n}$ dependence of linear bandits, showing that stochastic bandit convex optimization is fundamentally harder than linear bandits. For $d^2\le n\le d^{10/3}$, we obtain a lower bound of $\Omega(\sqrt{d}n^{3/4})$, matching the regret of the algorithm of Flaxman et al. (2005), establishing its optimality in this regime. translated_title: 隐藏曲率的代价：带状凸优化的改进下界
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.18652v3 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：我们为随机带状凸优化在$d$维欧几里得球上的$1$-Lipschitz函数建立了改进的最小最大期望遗憾下界。对于时间跨度$n\ge d^{10/3}$，我们证明了一个$\Omega(d^{4/3}\sqrt{n})$的下界，这是第一个超过线性带状问题$d\sqrt{n}$依赖性的非平凡界，表明随机带状凸优化从根本上比线性带状问题更难。对于$d^2\le n\le d^{10/3}$，我们获得了一个$\Omega(\sqrt{d}n^{3/4})$的下界，与Flaxman等人（2005）的算法遗憾相匹配，确立了该算法在此范围内的最优性。我们构造的硬凸函数类在$2d$维中具有以下形式：对于动作$a=(a^1,a^2)\in \mathbb{B}^{2d}$，每个函数是“管”的缩放软最大值，$r^{-1}\|W^\star a^1-\frac{r}{8\varepsilon}a^2 \|$（由$\varepsilon,r$超参数化），以及一个平方距离。
tldr: 本文通过构造具有隐藏曲率的凸函数类，首次证明了随机带状凸优化在$n\ge d^{10/3}$时遗憾下界超过线性带状问题的$d\sqrt{n}$，并在中等时间范围内匹配现有算法最优性，从而揭示了该问题的本质难度。
en_tdlr: This paper constructs a hard class of convex functions with hidden curvature, proving the first lower bound exceeding the $d\sqrt{n}$ dependence of linear bandits for $n\ge d^{10/3}$, and matching optimality in intermediate regimes, revealing fundamental hardness of stochastic bandit convex optimization.
